acceptance_criteria: Same tasks run with and without Hub using the same agent/model, prompts, repository revision, fixtures, and validation commands.
Record cloud input/output tokens, repeated tool-result tokens, tool-call counts, total completion time, validation success, and follow-up repairs per run.
Use separate authorized disposable roots and isolated Hub config/state; preserve run IDs and exact environment fingerprints.
Show no validation-quality regression and identify measurable token or time savings, or report neutral/negative results without retaining unsupported 80–95% claims.
Record evidence-bound results under docs/agent-evaluation/ and reconcile docs/TOKEN_ECONOMY.md.
task_p1_ab_evaluation.blocker: The 2026-11-09 306-file pair report is verified at SHA f5534317a2d33c4759397742e7961ab821a1e68354b24296333535bb38752ed0. Native and Hub transcripts confirm the exact synthetic task and separate disposable roots; final pytest runs passed 22 and 23 tests after one failed attempt each. The Hub transcript confirms two repo calls; measured pair showed +23,089 input tokens and +11,375 ms with Hub. However, the report says package contents were not hashed at A/B execution time; later RECORD hashes are post-run, and exact run-bound environment fingerprint remains unavailable. Different test suites mean equivalent validation coverage is unproven. TOKEN_ECONOMY now records the negative measured delta and limits.
task_p1_ab_evaluation.description: Run identical end-to-end coding tasks against a modern native-efficiency agent with and without Local AI Hub, using isolated roots and Hub state. Compare cloud input/output and repeated tool-result tokens, tool calls, duration, validation success, and follow-up repairs. Preserve honest neutral/negative results and revise unsupported savings claims.
task_p1_ab_evaluation.next_action: Keep P1-5 open and report the 306-file pair as a bounded, negative observation. Close only if exact run-bound environment provenance and comparable validation-quality evidence already exist in the retained artifacts; do not rerun or bypass native host policy without explicit authorization.
task_p1_ab_evaluation.title: P1-5: Provést A/B evaluaci reálné úspory tokenů a latence Hubu

acceptance_criteria: Benchmark measures TTFT, throughput, VRAM under load for available installed models across verified 8k, 16k and 32k contexts; unavailable 4B model recorded as limitation.
Scheduler memory bounds prevent VRAM OOM on 16GB GPU during concurrent desktop usage.
task_p1_gpu_admission.blocker: Report docs/agent-evaluation/round1-p1-6-gpu-benchmark-2026-11-09.md (SHA e9d707bdeb035a9afd24a6d9b6044ff73f500c87a03d2121de86e94d2db98790) verifies 3B/9B 8k/16k/32k prefill and only short same-/cross-model samples; it explicitly does not prove criterion #2, OOM prevention on 16GB during concurrent desktop use. scheduler.py SHA bebfeb213c460fd3151cbd01de986d777cc1b981a53b81bce3fb3fd853fa18b2, _admission lines 636-760, budgets min(total, available + reclaimable), with no explicit desktop-growth reserve there. vram_balancer.py SHA 9de2313ce621f42df5da1cb9a110988a3b12a66c0b018508bd79fbf9430e6fa6, lines 330-479, derives headroom/pressure from telemetry and scales context; no explicit desktop-growth reserve in inspected path. This is a source-level gap, not proof other guards are absent. Latest Stability thread reports GPU reservation unknown/manual intervention required and Hub gpu_admission_state outcome_unknown; prior free/available, inference_active, and preparing_model snapshots conflict. No safe stress window. 4B absence is documented, no pull authorized.
task_p1_gpu_admission.description: Observed 3B/9B context and short concurrency benchmark results are recorded in the linked report. This evidence satisfies the measured installed-model coverage/4B limitation criterion only within the tested samples; it does not establish the separate 16GB concurrent-desktop OOM-prevention acceptance criterion.
task_p1_gpu_admission.next_action: Stability owner to reconcile reservation/outcome and trace whole admission path for enforced desktop-growth bounds. If absent, implement under Stability ownership; then run an approved concurrent-desktop admission stress gate, retaining context, TTFT, throughput, VRAM, and reservation receipts. Keep P1-6 open until criterion #2 is evidenced; do not pull 4B.
task_p1_gpu_admission.title: P1-6: Zátěžové testy GPU admission a model routingu

Focused test passed before and after (5 passed); py_compile and git diff --check passed. Diff check emitted only existing LF-to-CRLF warnings.
